quotes.text:
calendar:
  calendar_count:
    type: labeled_string
    description: >
      How many calendars were set up, keyed by calendar type
      Types are e.g. "storage", "caldav", "ics" and various types from add-ons.

filelink:
  uploaded_size:
    type: labeled_counter
    description: >
      Accumulated file size (bytes) uploaded to FileLink services, keyed by
      FileLink provider type.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: calendar_count and read_only_calendar_count use labeled_string and set the current quantity. uploaded_size uses labeled_counter and accumulates bytes. Moving definitions in 558 preserves that difference. A schema category or filename is not permission to replace snapshot set operations with counter add operations. Cached Bug 1899602 discussion describes this choice, but only a curated record is available here; it does not complete the whole discussion pass. The current schema and callers independently support the code contract.
title: Keep telemetry snapshots distinct from accumulating counters
